scope: CLI first-request construction against a loopback capture endpoint only. No account, real model, or MTPLX inference was used.
setup: Fresh temporary CODEX_HOME for each case, custom Responses provider, requires_openai_auth=false, model=mtplx-test. The endpoint deliberately returned HTTP 400 after recording tool types; the CLI's nonzero request exit is expected.
limitations: The custom-provider capture did not advertise image_generation even when the feature was enabled. This does not contradict another model/account configuration advertising it.
A fresh home has no installed connectors, so this does not measure schema reduction for an account with apps installed.
No desktop app-server, extension, alternate client version, generated answer, tool execution, or inference throughput was validated.
